name: Windows Printer Deployment Failure
checks: Determine whether the printer is missing, installed but offline, or installed but failing to print.
Confirm the user/computer receives the intended Group Policy Preference printer item.
Confirm print server/share reachability and driver availability.
Only then remove/reinstall or modify the GPP action/driver configuration.
stop_condition: Stop when policy targeting, print-server reachability, driver state, or local queue state explains the failure.
resolution: Correct the isolated deployment/driver/queue issue instead of broadly rebuilding printing.
